data.name: Futurika Online
data.detailed_description:
Futurika Online is a free-to-play, pixel art cyberpunk MMORPG featuring real-time, action-oriented combat and story-driven progression.

Explore neon-lit cities, snow mountain regions, underground zones, and corporate-controlled districts as you carve out your place in a shared online world.

CHOOSE YOUR ROLE

Select one of three distinct classes:

  • Netrunner — Hacking, control, and support

  • Cyber Samurai — High-speed melee combat

  • Brawler — Durable frontline fighter

Each class offers a unique combat style, progression path, and class-driven storylines.

REAL-TIME COMBAT

Combat is real-time and movement-based.
Run, dash, and actively use abilities, items, and tactical tools while positioning and timing determine the outcome of each fight.

Face enemies ranging from street-level threats to elite units and bosses, playable solo or cooperatively.

STORY AND SIDE CONTENT

Follow a main storyline set in a fractured cyberpunk world, filled with hidden threats and unresolved tensions.

Take on optional jobs, side quests, and combat encounters spread throughout the world as you progress.

ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT

Futurika Online is actively developed, with ongoing updates planned to expand the world, introduce new content, and refine gameplay systems over time.

Players can follow development updates, announcements, and community discussions on both Steam and the official Discord.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (OpenGL 3.0+)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum supported display resolution: 1280×720.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS or Linux (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (OpenGL 3.0+)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum supported display resolution: 1280×720.
